+    {A B : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] {F : A ⥤ B} {U : B ⥤ A}
+    (a : F ⊣ U) {K : A} {N : B} (η : K ⟶ U.obj N)
+    (hη : ∀ P, Function.Bijective (fun f : N ⟶ P ↦ η ≫ U.map f)) :
+    Nonempty (F.obj K ≅ N) := by
+  let f := (a.homEquiv K N).symm η
+  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (hη (F.obj K)).surjective (a.unit.app K)
+  change η ≫ U.map g = a.unit.app K at hg
+  have hf : a.unit.app K ≫ U.map f = η := by
+    exact (a.homEquiv K N).apply_symm_apply η
+  refine ⟨⟨f, g, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
+  · apply (a.homEquiv K (F.obj K)).injective
+    simp only [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Functor.map_comp, ← Category.assoc]
+    rw [hf, hg]
+    simp
+  · apply (hη N).injective
+    simp only [Functor.map_comp, ← Category.assoc]
+    rw [hg, hf]
+    simp

+chosen extension of K with N. (blueprint: lem-coef-constant-derived-scalar-adjunction) -/
+theorem nonempty_iso_internalHom_derivedRestrictScalars
+    {R S : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S)
+    {K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))}
+    {N : DerivedCategory (Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} S))}
+    (η : K ⟶ (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars J φ).obj N)
+    (hη : Sheaf.IsDerivedBaseChange η)
+    (L : DerivedCategory (Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} S))) :
+    Nonempty ((ihom K).obj ((Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars J φ).obj L) ≅
+      (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars J φ).obj ((ihom N).obj L)) := by
+  obtain ⟨F, ⟨a⟩, hF⟩ := exists_scalarExtension_tensorAdjunction J φ
+  obtain ⟨e⟩ := universal_iso_leftAdjoint a η hη
+  obtain ⟨μ⟩ := hF K
+  let δ := conjugateIsoEquiv
+    (a.comp (ihom.adjunction (F.obj K))) ((ihom.adjunction K).comp a) μ
+  exact ⟨(δ.app L).symm ≪≫ (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars J φ).mapIso
+    ((MonoidalClosed.internalHom.mapIso e.symm.op).app L)⟩
+
